Generic Calculator using Function & Class Templates

Problem Statement:
You are asked to design a generic calculator system that works with different data types.

🔹 Requirements
1️⃣ Create a Function Template
template <typename T>
T add(T a, T b);

Returns the sum of two values.

Must work for:

int

double

string

2️⃣ Create a Class Template
template <typename T>
class Calculator

The class must contain:

Constructor to initialize two values.

Member functions:

T multiply()

T subtract()

🔹 Input Format
type value1 value2

Where:

int

double

string

🔹 Output Format

For numeric types:

Addition: <result>
Subtraction: <result>
Multiplication: <result>

For string:

Only addition (concatenation) is valid.

Print:

Addition: <concatenated_string>
Subtraction: Not Supported
Multiplication: Not Supported
